Key audit matter:
Revaluations of land and buildings (properties)
During the year, the group revalued its land and buildings
(properties) as disclosed in Note 17. The revaluations were carried
out by external professional valuers using the earnings approach and
replacement cost method.
The earnings approach used to value property involve significant
judgements about future performance of the properties and discount
rates.
How our audit addressed the key audit ma:
We assessed the competence, qualification and independence of the
expert.
We held discussions with the valuation expert in order to understand
the methodology and results of the valuation.
We obtained the future cash flow forecasts and the underlying
assumptions given to the expert by management and checked the
accuracy of the inputs. We also assessed the reasonableness of the
growth rates, profit margins and discount rates applied.
We evaluated and challenged the future forecasts based on the
historical performance of the properties, industry-specific reports
and the macro economic outlook.
We reviewed the adequacy of disclosures made in Note 17 of the
financial statements.
